tactics: induction h with | head as => exact ⟨[], as, rfl⟩ | tail b _ ih => exact match ih with | ⟨s, t, e⟩ => ⟨b :: s, t, by rw [e]; rfl⟩
induction h with | head as => exact ⟨[], as, rfl⟩ | tail b _ ih => obtain ⟨s, t, e⟩ := ih; exact ⟨b :: s, t, by simp [e]⟩
induction l with | nil => simp at h | cons x xs ih => rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with e | m; · exact ⟨[], xs, by rw [e]; rfl⟩; · obtain ⟨s, t, e⟩ := ih m; exact ⟨x :: s, t, by simp [e]⟩
